title: CreatePrivateLinkEndpointRequest
description: Request object for the CreatePrivateLinkEndpoint method.

cloudServiceProvider.description: Cloud Service Provider. Currently supporting AWS and AZURE.

enablePrivateDns.description: Enable Private DNS for Private Link endpoint.

awsAccountDetails.description: AWS account details where the Private Link endpoint is created.

azureAccountDetails.description: Azure account details where Private Link endpoint is created.

resourceTags.description: Custom tags for the different cloud resources created during Private Links creation.

AWSAccountDetails.description: Details of the cloud network and the cross-account role required to create the Private Link endpoint.

cloudAccountId.description: Account ID to authorize access for Private Link.

credentialCrn.description: CDP Credential CRN to fetch the AWS cross-account RoleArn for the account where the endpoint gets deleted.

vpcId.description: VPC ID in which the Private Link should be created.

subnetIds.description: IDs of the private subnets in which the Private Link should be created.

AzureAccountDetails.description: Details of the cloud network and the cross-account role required to create the Private Link endpoint.

azureClientSecretCredential.description: Azure client secret credential, either this or credential CRN should be passed.

credentialCrn.description: CDP Credential CRN to fetch the Azure client secret credentials, either this or AzureClientSecretCredential should be passed.

subscriptionId.description: The Subscription for which the Private Link service to be allowed/accessible.

resourceGroup.description: The resource group under which the private endpoint is to be created.

location.description: Azure location where endpoint should be created.

vNetId.description: vNet ID in which the Private Link should be created.

subnetId.description: ID of the private subnet in which the Private Link should be created.

AzureClientSecretCredential.description: Azure client secret credential, either this or credential CRN should be passed.

clientId.description: The client (application) ID of the service principal

clientSecret.description: A client secret that was generated for the App Registration used to authenticate the client.

tenantId.description: The Azure Active Directory tenant (directory) Id of the service principal.

CloudServiceProvider.description:
Supported cloud providers
 `AWS` - A value indicating AWS as supported cloud provider for creating Private Links. `AZURE` - A value indicating Azure as supported cloud provider for creating Private Links.

externalId.description: External ID associated with the cross-account role.

ResourceTag.description: Tag object which can be passed to add custom tags for the cloud resources.
